:::{#def-evaluation-bracket}
#### Evaluation bracket

For a function $F$ and numbers $a$ and $b$ where $F$ is defined,
the **evaluation bracket** is the difference

$$\sb{F(t)}_{t=a}^{t=b} \eqdef F(b) - F(a).$$

When the variable is clear from the context, it is written $\sb{F(t)}_a^b$.
Computing $F(b) - F(a)$ from the bracket is called **evaluating at the limits**
(the [limits of integration](notation.qmd#def-lower-upper-limits) $a$ and $b$).

:::
